name: SOL zfav maker, drift-only filter
description: sol-zfav-maker's rule (post-only bid one tick inside on the side SOL spot is >=1.5 sigma past the strike, 420..150 s) but only when the displacement since the window open is drift-like: the largest 10 s move is at most 45% of the total move since open. Jump-driven displacements are skipped.
hypothesis: The spot-confirmed favourite is underpriced when the displacement came from steady drift (persistent order flow) but fairly priced or adversely selected when one 10 s jump produced most of it (liquidation/news spike: informed takers already moved the book, fills come from people who know more). Screen on sol-zfav-maker's 6,614 dev fills (Jan-Sep, 5 quintiles of jump share): fills with jump share <=0.45 net +1.85c (3,922, se 0.30) vs +0.07c (2,594, se 0.43) above; low side positive in 8/9 months and in Jun-Sep +2.3/+1.2/+1.7/+1.7 vs -1.5/-0.7/+0.6/-0.7. Threshold 0.45 is the quintile edge from that screen (0.35 and 0.55 give the same picture: +1.95/+0.58 and +1.51/-0.03). Wrong if the engine run does not improve on the parent's +1.18c pooled with a CI above zero, or the gain disappears in the lockbox. Multiple-screen caveat: three filters screened (market-wide agreement, flow, jump share); only this one separated.
